required_findings.title: Separate attempted launch, returned child PID and successful capture; spawning alone does not establish original-device execution
required_findings.problem: run() catches a Popen exception and returns a failed attempt row with no PID. The caller still appends that row and records native_children=len(runs), so the ordinary failed-launch path is counted as a native child. If Popen returns, actual_original_x86_capture is set true before exit/log/output validation; successful spawn of the native loader does not prove that original device exports or a successful original capture occurred.
required_findings.independent_source_basis: The fresh driver loads the bundle and resolves exports before opening script/output or executing create/rate/Calc. Missing export, loader failure, initialization/fault, script/output-open failure and other early exits can precede the requested capture. A returned loader PID proves only the identified process launch boundary, not all downstream original execution. On failure the available logs may support a narrower original-call observation or leave it unknown.

concrete_paths.scenario: Popen raises without returning a child object/PID
concrete_paths.frozen_metadata: Failed row is appended; native_children becomes1, although no successful native-loader launch is recorded. actual_original_x86_capture remainsfalse.
concrete_paths.correct_distinction: One attempted launch; zero returned/known loader PIDs; zero valid captures. Do not claim that no OS subprocess ever briefly existed solely from the exception: the known boundary is Popen did not return a usable child.

concrete_paths.scenario: Popen returns PID, loader exits before original device exports/capture
concrete_paths.frozen_metadata: actual_original_x86_capture istrue even though full capture is invalid and original-device execution may be absent/unknown.
concrete_paths.correct_distinction: One returned loader child; zero valid captures. Original-device execution must be separately supported by retained source/log observations, or remain unknown.

concrete_paths.scenario: Returned child times out or fails after partial original work
concrete_paths.frozen_metadata: actual_original_x86_capture staystrue without distinguishing partial/unknown execution from a valid complete capture.
concrete_paths.correct_distinction: Retain spawned/timeout/failure evidence; do not promote it to a successful capture. Partial original-call evidence is distinct from completion.

required_findings.why_material: The packet is designed to retain failed outcomes and account for a tightly bounded original-execution selection. Miscounting launch attempts as native children and overclaiming execution from spawn makes that failure evidence misleading, even though valid_capture correctly prevents continuation after structural failure. This is a provenance defect, not an observed extra call or failure of the silent-output policy.
minimum_remedy: Preserve all11 frozen preparation files/manifest and this required-finding review. Make a minimal additive successor, retaining scripts/vectors/event coordinates/source pins/protocol/diagnostic windows and stop policy.

Record explicit per-row attempt/Popen-returned-PID state and aggregate attempt, known spawned-loader and valid-capture counts. Name each count according to the boundary actually observed; do not use len(attempt rows) as spawned/native-child count.

Rename/remove the premature actual_original_x86_capture flag or make its meaning accurately conditional. A child-created/loader-spawned flag must not assert original exports executed. Successful complete captures can be recorded after current clean status/log/length/finiteness validation; failed paths must retain unknown or precisely supported partial-execution provenance.

Add bounded data-only/AST or separately isolated analyst accounting fixtures for failed Popen, returned early loader failure, timeout/invalid capture and success. Do not launch the collector/native device to exercise the correction. Re-review the exact focused successor before Root chooses the new original calls.
required_findings.not_observed: No actual launch failure, timeout, original execution or changed output was observed here. The finding is independently established from the complete source control flow.
